Container.Name: ironsbot
Container.Overview: IronsBot custom image for Seer information queries, NoneBot2/OneBot v11 messaging, and personal Unraid-friendly plugins. Version tags use latest plus upstream-version.fork-revision tags and exact sha tags; recent changes include AI chat, persistent Bilibili login data, startup notices, scheduled messages, and team group shortcuts.
Container.Description: IronsBot is a QQ bot based on NoneBot2 and OneBot v11. This custom image follows the upstream IronsBot project and adds local custom plugins for fixed image replies, Tencent Meeting replies, event links, Bilibili dynamic monitoring, scheduled private messages, startup notices, team group query shortcuts, and AI chat through OpenAI-compatible APIs. Docker image tags keep latest available and also use the current upstream version plus this fork revision. Private values such as QQ IDs, group IDs, tokens, account credentials, meeting numbers, and AI keys are configured at runtime through this template. Persistent plugin data, Bilibili cookies, and database caches are stored under /app/data. Startup database downloads are disabled by default; scheduled updates remain enabled, and superusers can send 更新数据 or 数据更新 to refresh immediately.
Container.Requires: Requires a OneBot v11 client such as NapCat. Configure the client reverse WebSocket to ws://UNRAID_SERVER_IP:8085/onebot/v11/ws, or use ws://ironsbot:8080/onebot/v11/ws when both containers share a Docker network. Changelog/version check: latest remains available; fixed builds are tagged as upstream-version.fork-revision plus sha-xxxxxxx. See the Docker Hub README / ReadMe link for full notes.
Container.Changes:
Version scheme: - latest: current main branch of this fork. - upstream-version.fork-revision: current upstream IronsBot version plus this fork revision. - sha-xxxxxxx: exact Git commit used to build the image.
Recent changes: - Added DeepSeek/OpenAI-compatible AI chat through bot mentions. - Added persistent Bilibili login data under /app/data. - Added startup notice, scheduled private messages, team group query shortcuts, and manual database refresh. - Improved Unraid template fields for runtime-only private configuration.

Config.Name: WebSocket Port
Config.Description: Host port mapped to IronsBot internal port 8080.

Config.Name: IronsBot Data
Config.Description: Persistent data directory for plugin caches, Bilibili cookies, and local database cache files.

Config.Name: Environment
Config.Description: NoneBot environment name.

Config.Name: Driver
Config.Description: NoneBot driver setting.

Config.Name: Host
Config.Description: IronsBot listen host inside container.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: IronsBot listen port inside container.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: TRACE / DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR.

Config.Name: Command Start
Config.Description: NoneBot command prefixes.

Config.Name: DB Sync On Startup
Config.Description: Run remote database sync during startup. Leave false to avoid slow startup; cached data loads from /app/data. Superusers can send 更新数据 or 数据更新 manually.

Config.Name: DB Sync Interval Enabled
Config.Description: Enable scheduled database sync jobs after startup. Enabled by default; set false only if you want manual-only updates.

Config.Name: OneBot Access Token
Config.Description: Access token used by NapCat or another OneBot v11 client to connect to IronsBot.

Config.Name: Superusers
Config.Description: NoneBot superuser QQ list, for example ["123456789"].

Config.Name: Superuser Groups
Config.Description: QQ groups treated as enabled test/management groups for custom plugins, for example [123456789].

Config.Name: Superuser Group Bypass
Config.Description: Allow superusers to use custom group commands even when the current group is not enabled. Default false.

Config.Name: SeerAPI Sync URL
Config.Description: Remote SeerAPI SQLite database URL.

Config.Name: SeerAPI Fingerprint URL
Config.Description: Remote SeerAPI SHA256 fingerprint URL.

Config.Name: SeerAPI Sync Interval
Config.Description: SeerAPI sync interval in minutes.

Config.Name: SeerAPI Local Path
Config.Description: Local cache/fallback SeerAPI database path. Keep /app/data mounted for persistence.

Config.Name: Alias Sync URL
Config.Description: Remote alias SQLite database URL.

Config.Name: Alias Fingerprint URL
Config.Description: Remote alias SHA256 fingerprint URL.

Config.Name: Alias Sync Interval
Config.Description: Alias database sync interval in minutes.

Config.Name: Alias Local Path
Config.Description: Local cache/fallback alias database path. Keep /app/data mounted for persistence.

Config.Name: Render Cache Dir
Config.Description: Rendered image cache directory.

Config.Name: Render Cache Max MB
Config.Description: Rendered image cache max size in MB.

Config.Name: Headless Seer User ID
Config.Description: Optional Seer user ID / Mimi number for features that require login.

Config.Name: Headless Seer Password
Config.Description: Optional MD5 password for the headless Seer login client.

Config.Name: Headless Reconnect Retries
Config.Description: Headless client reconnect retry count.

Config.Name: Headless Failure Notice
Config.Description: Notify Superusers by private message when the configured headless Seer login is not available after startup.

Config.Name: Headless Failure Notice Message
Config.Description: Private message sent to Superusers when headless Seer login is unavailable. Variables: {user_id}, {reason}.

Config.Name: Player Query Sections
Config.Description: Sections shown by custom Mimi ID queries. Supported: basic, appearance, social, collection, rank, local_rank, achievement, peak, titles, pets, stages, battle, raw. Use all for every section.

Config.Name: Team Query Sections
Config.Description: Sections shown by custom team queries. Supported: basic, resource, facilities, status, logo, text. Use all for every section.

Config.Name: Player Rank Search Limit
Config.Description: When querying a Mimi ID, scan this many top entries in the global book and achievement rankings. Set 0 to disable rank lookup.

Config.Name: Player Rank Page Size
Config.Description: Ranking entries fetched per request for Mimi ID rank lookup. The 4481 ranking API should stay at 100 or less.

Config.Name: Peak Season Subkey
Config.Description: Optional peak season ranking subkey for custom Mimi ID queries. Leave empty to read the current season from SeerAPI data; set YYYYMMDD manually if season data is unavailable.

Config.Name: Local Queried Rank
Config.Description: Enable local rankings among Mimi IDs queried by this bot. Tied scores are shown as tied ranks.

Config.Name: Local Queried Rank Cache
Config.Description: SQLite cache file for local queried-player rankings. Peak season metrics are compared only within the same season subkey.

Config.Name: Meeting Reply Number
Config.Description: Tencent Meeting number, for example 1234567890 or 123-456-7890. The meeting URL is generated automatically.

Config.Name: Meeting Reply Template
Config.Description: Meeting reply template. Variables: {meeting_number}, {meeting_digits}, {meeting_url}.

Config.Name: Meeting Reply Groups
Config.Description: QQ groups allowed to use meeting reply; Superuser Groups are included automatically.

Config.Name: Meeting Reply Users
Config.Description: QQ users allowed to use meeting reply in private chat; Superusers are included automatically.

Config.Name: Text Send Mention Trigger User
Config.Description: When enabled, group text replies start by mentioning the triggering QQ user. Disabled by default.

Config.Name: Text Send Private Commands
Config.Description: Generic private text replies. Empty allowed_user_ids means Superusers only. Example: [{"id":"ping","commands":["ping"],"allowed_user_ids":[123456789],"message":"pong"}].

Config.Name: Text Send Private Schedules
Config.Description: Generic scheduled private text messages. Empty user_ids sends to Superusers. Example: [{"id":"morning","user_ids":[123456789],"hour":8,"minute":30,"message":"hello"}].

Config.Name: Text Send Group Commands
Config.Description: Generic group text replies. Empty group_ids means Superuser Groups only. Info page example: [{"id":"seerinfo_page","group_ids":[123456789],"commands":["xm","xrym","雷小伊","重聚"],"message":"https://seerinfo.yuyuqaq.cn/"}].

Config.Name: Text Send Group Schedules
Config.Description: Generic scheduled group text messages. Empty group_ids sends to Superuser Groups. Example: [{"id":"night","group_ids":[123456789],"hour":23,"minute":0,"message":"good night"}].

Config.Name: Activity Reminder Enabled
Config.Description: Scan SeerAPI activity end times at startup and daily midnight, then send ending reminders.

Config.Name: Activity Reminder Groups
Config.Description: QQ groups receiving activity ending reminders. Superuser Groups are included automatically.

Config.Name: Activity Reminder Users
Config.Description: QQ users receiving private activity ending reminders. Superusers are included automatically.

Config.Name: Activity Reminder Lead Hours
Config.Description: Reminder lead times in hours before an activity ends. Example: [11,1].

Config.Name: Activity Reminder Grace Minutes
Config.Description: If startup/midnight scanning missed a reminder time by this many minutes, send it immediately.

Config.Name: Activity Reminder Only Shown
Config.Description: Only remind activities visible in the SeerAPI activity center.

Config.Name: Activity Reminder Cache Path
Config.Description: SQLite cache storing sent activity reminders to prevent duplicate messages.

Config.Name: Activity Reminder Message
Config.Default: ⏰ 活动将在约 {lead_hours} 小时后结束 {activity_list}
Config.Description: Activity ending reminder text. Variables: {lead_hours}, {activity_count}, {activity_list}. Superusers can send /当前活动, /活动列表, or /活动时间 to check active activities.

Container.Config: ⏰ 活动将在约 {lead_hours} 小时后结束 {activity_list}

Config.Name: Team Group Shortcut Groups
Config.Description: QQ team groups where the shortcut command should trigger team queries. Superuser Groups are included automatically.

Config.Name: Team Group Shortcut Team IDs
Config.Description: Team IDs queried for the team group shortcut command, for example [1234567,7654321]. Keep private values out of Git.

Config.Name: Team Group Shortcut Commands
Config.Description: Exact team group shortcut commands that trigger the configured team queries.

Config.Name: Team Resource Notice Users
Config.Description: QQ users to @ when any configured team resource is below 1000. Use [123456789] or 123456789. Keep private user IDs here instead of committing them to Git.

Config.Name: Team Resource Notice Message
Config.Default: 出来买资源，别逼我求你😡
Config.Description: Message sent after @ mentions when team resource is below 1000.

Container.Config: 出来买资源，别逼我求你😡

Config.Name: Startup Notice Enabled
Config.Description: Send a private startup notice after the bot connects. SUPERUSERS receive it automatically.

Config.Name: Startup Notice Message
Config.Description: Private message sent when IronsBot starts and connects.

Config.Name: Startup Notice Delay
Config.Description: Extra seconds to wait after startup services are ready before sending the startup notice.

Config.Name: AI Chat API Key
Config.Description: DeepSeek API key. Keep this private.

Config.Name: AI Chat Base URL
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL. For relay/NewAPI services, usually use the /v1 endpoint, for example https://example.com/v1.

Config.Name: AI Chat Model
Config.Description: Model name used by the configured AI chat provider.

Config.Name: AI Chat System Prompt
Config.Default: You are IronsBot, a QQ group bot for Seer information queries. Help users discuss Seer pets, skills, abilities, stats, type matchups, events, and bot usage. You may chat naturally, but keep replies concise, friendly, and honest. If unsure, say so instead of inventing facts.
Config.Description: System prompt sent to the AI model.

Container.Config: You are IronsBot, a QQ group bot for Seer information queries. Help users discuss Seer pets, skills, abilities, stats, type matchups, events, and bot usage. You may chat naturally, but keep replies concise, friendly, and honest. If unsure, say so instead of inventing facts.

Config.Name: AI Chat Allowed Groups
Config.Description: QQ groups whose members may use AI chat by mentioning the bot. Superuser Groups are included automatically.

Config.Name: AI Chat Allowed Users
Config.Description: QQ users allowed to use AI chat outside group-wide allowlists. Private chats also allow Superusers.

Config.Name: AI Chat History Turns
Config.Description: Conversation history turns kept per user.

Config.Name: AI Chat Timeout Seconds
Config.Description: AI API request timeout in seconds.

Config.Name: AI Chat Max Tokens
Config.Description: Maximum generated tokens per AI reply.

Config.Name: AI Chat Temperature
Config.Description: AI sampling temperature from 0 to 2.

Config.Name: AI Chat Thinking Enabled
Config.Description: Enable DeepSeek thinking mode. Disabled is usually faster for casual chat.

Config.Name: AI Chat Waiting Notice
Config.Description: Send a short waiting message before calling the AI API.

Config.Name: AI Chat Max Reply Chars
Config.Description: Maximum characters sent back to QQ before truncation.

Config.Name: Bilibili Monitor UID
Config.Description: Legacy single Bilibili UID to monitor. Used only when BILI_UIDS is empty.

Config.Name: Bilibili Monitor UIDs
Config.Description: Multiple Bilibili UIDs to monitor from the logged-in subscription feed, for example [1310714247,123456789]. When non-empty, this overrides BILI_UID.

Config.Name: Bilibili Data Directory
Config.Description: Directory for Bilibili cookie and dynamic timestamp cache. Keep /app/data mounted for persistence.

Config.Name: Bilibili Check Interval
Config.Description: Bilibili dynamic check interval in minutes.

Config.Name: Bilibili Sleep Start Hour
Config.Description: Low-frequency check start hour.

Config.Name: Bilibili Sleep End Hour
Config.Description: Low-frequency check end hour.

Config.Name: Bilibili Sleep Interval
Config.Description: Low-frequency check interval in minutes.

Config.Name: Bilibili Target Groups
Config.Description: QQ groups receiving Bilibili dynamic updates. Superuser Groups are included automatically.

Config.Name: Bilibili Target Users
Config.Description: QQ users receiving Bilibili dynamic updates in private chat. Superusers are included automatically.
